mentions.name: Thai chess game server
mentions.description: A game server for playing Thai chess, inspired by lichess.org and planning to use several of its assets. The backend is written in Rust, with frontend board rendering and move logic already in progress and an API planned next.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started to work on an an idea I've head for a while, to create a game server to play Thai chess inspired by lichess.org, in fact, I plan to use several of their assets.
